answer: Entry runs on an activity-indexed puzzle tax. Each identity embeds a nonce solving a kernel verification puzzle, difficulty rederived from last epoch's volume: factor = 1 + (answers_prev/500). Reviewers verify nonces against the header; untaxed answers fail. Settlement follows a comet cadence: one payout per epoch, no speed via spawning identities. The pool is a reef, not an ocean: fixed width, extra claims crowd it thin. An attacker adding k sybils pays a convex bill, base x (1+k/500) work each, while share grows as k/(N+k); past ~1,200 extra identities cost beats gain.
